name: Differential abundance
description: Which taxa differ between two groups of a long taxon profile table: per-taxon Mann-Whitney U on relative abundance (zeros included), Benjamini-Hochberg q-values, prevalence and mean abundance per group, a log2 fold change, and a volcano plot. The two groups default to the two most frequent values of the group role.

inputs.label: Taxon profiles (long)
inputs.description: One row per taxon per sample with read counts and a group role with at least two values.

group_a.title: Group A
group_a.description: A value of the group role; empty picks the most frequent one.

group_b.title: Group B
group_b.description: The other value; empty picks the second most frequent one.

min_prevalence_pct.title: Minimum prevalence (%)
min_prevalence_pct.description: Only taxa present in at least this share of samples in either group are tested.

q_threshold.title: Significance (q)
q_threshold.description: Taxa with a q-value below this are marked significant.

rank.title: Taxonomic rank
rank.description: When the table maps a rank role, use taxa of this rank only.

remove_artifacts.title: Remove curated artifacts
remove_artifacts.description: Drop taxa on curation lists with the artifact role before testing.

outputs.name: differential_abundance
outputs.description: One row per tested taxon: prevalence and mean relative abundance per group, log2 fold change, U, p and q.

outputs.name: volcano
outputs.description: log2 fold change against -log10 p, significant taxa highlighted.

citation: Built with pandas, NumPy, SciPy (Virtanen et al. 2020) and Plotly. Two-sided Mann-Whitney U with Benjamini-Hochberg control, following the INDIVO Explorer differential-abundance page. See README.md for details.
